notes.title: Patch 1.0.16
notes.notes:
Enjoy even more exiting games thanks to the new AI system.
in the updated multiplayer mode you will play not only with normal player, but you will face and team with the new AI system. Moving around the map Bots will act as real players: interacting with reactors, teaming with their teammates and hunting players.
Are you ready to face them?
Try the new Hidden update
